title: Degraded-mode latch freezes surplus free-settlement withdrawals for healthy open positions
hypothesis: SECURITY.md degraded containment only promises to block further risk expansion and still permit protective transitions. Live checkWithdraw -> validateWithdraw reverts on any open position while degradedMode is set, even when post-withdraw equity would remain above init/FAD and all VPI/carry floors. A single profitable close/liquidation that leaves E < L latches the flag; every other trader with a live position then cannot withdraw surplus free CH cash until the owner recapitalizes and calls clearDegradedMode. Flattening remains possible, so this is a freeze-of-surplus rather than permanent seizure, but it is user harm from a legitimate peer close, not owner malice.
why_not_known_issue: SECURITY.md known limitations do not list open-position withdrawal freeze under degradedMode. The invariant table describes degradedMode as a risk-expansion latch, not a CH free-cash freeze. Scan titles about HousePool.payOut skipping L+B and about E<L-then-latch do not cover this remaining withdrawal guard.
gate1_reason: Code path is live: CfdEngine.checkWithdraw (line 730) always delegates to sidecar.validateWithdraw; sidecar lines 274-276 revert CfdEngine__DegradedMode whenever pos.size != 0. Latch is permissionless via close/liq in CfdEngine._enterDegradedModeIfInsolvent (line 1351) comparing P-C to L with pendingPoolPayout=0. Clearance is owner-only (CfdEngine.clearDegradedMode, line 658) and requires E >= L again. Surplus free settlement is CH custody, not pool L-backing, so the extra freeze is not implied by E<L containment.

poc_spec.setup: Seed HousePool so E is only slightly above L. Two accounts: Whale with a large in-the-money close, Victim with a healthy overcollateralized position plus extra free settlement in MarginClearinghouse (not pledged).
poc_spec.actors: Whale trader (or their keeper-executed close), Victim trader, protocol owner for recap.
steps: Victim deposits surplus free settlement on top of init-margin pledge and leaves a position open.
Confirm Victim.withdraw of the surplus succeeds while degradedMode is false and health remains above init.
Execute Whale's profitable full close so HousePool.totalAssets() net of claims drops below max(long,short) maxProfit. Engine latches degradedMode.
Victim calls withdraw on the same surplus amount without closing.
Optionally Victim fully closes, then withdraws remaining free settlement.
poc_spec.assert: Step 4 reverts CfdEngine__DegradedMode even though leftover pledge+claim still exceeds init/FAD. Step 5 (flatten first) succeeds. Funds are not stolen but surplus is frozen for as long as E < L.
poc_spec.foundry_hint: packages/perps/test/perps/accounting or engine settlement tests that already latch degradedMode on a profitable close; extend with a second account's withdrawMargin.

title: Liquidation reachable-collateral diagnostic includes VPI reserve that cannot pay price loss or the liq charge
hypothesis: planLiquidation sets settlementReachableAssets = pos.margin + traderClaim + vpiRebateReserve and copies it to liquidationReachableCollateralAssets / LiquidationAccountingLib.reachableCollateralAssets. Exact price health immediately below uses only pledge+claim. The keeper/protocol/LP charge is separately capped by the dedicated liquidation reserve. CfdEngineLens copies that field into preview.reachableCollateralAssets (CfdEngineLens.sol:628). A consumer treating the field as 'what liquidation can seize' overstates seizable assets by the VPI floor, which is only reachable for matching negative-VPI clawback. This is claim/cash/reserve confusion on an in-scope lens, not a live custody drain.
why_not_known_issue: Known scan items cover inverted liq-price search and open-preview liq-price inversion, not this VPI-in-reachable-collateral mix. PlanTypes comments call the field diagnostic, but ICfdEngineTypes still describes it as settlement reachable by liquidation before the charge — a remaining ABI/docs mismatch at this pin.
gate1_reason: Confirmed at CfdEnginePlanLib.sol:1451-1462: comment says VPI is only for clawback and price health uses pledge+claim, yet settlementReachableAssets still adds snap.vpiRebateReserveAssets. Lens line 628 publishes it. Live applyLiquidationSettlementPlan seizes settlementSeizedAssets (price-loss pledge + LP fee) and charges from the liquidation reserve, not from VPI except consumeVpiRebateReserve for clawback. No extra tokens move, but preview/live field parity is broken.

poc_spec.setup: Account with a liquidatable position, nonzero dedicated vpiRebateReserveBalances backing negative lifetime VPI, plus a small liquidation reserve.
poc_spec.actors: Keeper liquidator, liquidated trader, off-chain consumer of CfdEngineLens.previewLiquidation.
steps: Seed negative vpiAccrued with matching vpiRebateReserveAssets > 0.
Drive the position to exact-price liquidatable on pledge+claim only.
Call CfdEngineLens.previewLiquidation and record reachableCollateralAssets, liquidationChargeAssets, keeper/protocol/LP split.
Execute live liquidatePosition at the same price and compare CH bucket deltas: pnlPledge, liquidationReserve, vpiRebateReserve, claims.
poc_spec.assert: Preview.reachableCollateralAssets includes the VPI reserve. Live price-loss + charge do not debit that VPI reserve except the clawback path. Charge is capped by liquidation reserve, so preview overstates seizable collateral by ~vpiRebateReserveAssets.
poc_spec.foundry_hint: packages/perps/test/perps/accounting/liquidation and CfdEngineLens preview tests; compare lens reachableCollateralAssets to CH vpiRebateReserveAssets before/after.

title: Sidecar execute* auth bypass via CH operator discovery
hypothesis: An untrusted keeper or random caller could invoke executeOpen/executeClose/executeLiquidation or CH onlyOperator methods and mutate custody.
why_not_known_issue: N/A — killed; not a remaining bug.
gate1_reason: executeOpen/Close/Liq use onlyEngine (line 146) requiring msg.sender == immutable ENGINE. buildRawSnapshot additionally allows ENGINE.planningReader(), which is onlyEngine on the host. CH onlyOperator (MarginClearinghouse.sol:226) fail-closes if engine==0 and otherwise requires msg.sender == engine or engine.settlementSidecar() via try/catch _isSettlementSidecar (line 1369) returning false on revert. No public path for keepers.

steps: Call sidecar.executeClose/executeOpen/executeLiquidation as non-engine.
Call CH.consumeActionCharge / unlockCloseMargin / settleAssets as non-operator.
poc_spec.assert: All revert Unauthorized / NotOperator. No balances change.

title: Reservation double-release: consumeActionCharge then terminal reservation release
hypothesis: Full close/liquidation FIFO-consumes committed-order margin, then router terminal cleanup releases the same reservation into free settlement, inflating CH credits without tokens.
why_not_known_issue: SECURITY.md already documents same-account FIFO consumption of sibling committed margin on full close as anti-shielding. Remaining question was whether Consumed records can be released again.
gate1_reason: releaseOrderReservationForTerminalCleanup (line 663) returns 0 unless status==Active. _consumeReservation sets remaining to 0 and closes as Consumed (line 800). Subsequent release sees non-Active and no-ops. consumeActionCharge requires the planned committed split to match live FIFO (line 967) and reverts IncompleteReservationCoverage if FIFO cannot cover. No second unlock of the same atoms.

poc_spec.setup: Account with a live position plus a queued open that still has an Active committed-order reservation.
poc_spec.actors: Same-account trader, keeper executing FIFO close then cleanup.
steps: Full-close the position so action charges consume sibling committed margin.
Router calls releaseOrderReservationForTerminalCleanup on the consumed order id.
Compare settlementBalances vs token balance vs locked buckets.
poc_spec.assert: Second release returns 0; no extra free settlement. Custody still equals credited balances.

title: Trader claims used as cash to fund carry, VPI, fees, frozen spread, or bounties
hypothesis: Outstanding traderClaimBalanceAssets could be spent as pool cash for action charges or bounties, desynchronizing C from P and stealing LP/claimant funds.
why_not_known_issue: Claim-vs-cash boundary is an explicit SECURITY.md invariant; remaining bug would need a live path that actually spends C as cash.
gate1_reason: _planCloseCashSources spends spendable action reserve, free settlement, released VPI remainder, terminal liq-reserve surplus, released pledge, then committed-order margin. Claims are only netted against price loss (pricePnlClaimConsumedAssets) and counted as health collateral in _limitCloseReleaseByHealth (comment at 1136). CashPriorityLib.reserveFreshPayouts treats C as senior to fresh payouts. consumeActionCharge never reads claim storage. Open costs debit CH free/pledge, not claims.

poc_spec.setup: Trader with large claim, tiny free settlement, frozen close that assesses spread+fee+carry.
steps: Leave claim outstanding (payOut skipped because P < C or payout recorded as claim).
Execute close/open/liq whose action charges exceed free+reserve+pledge surplus.
Observe CH claim storage vs pool.totalAssets() vs actionChargeCollectedAssets.
poc_spec.assert: Claim balance is unchanged except explicit price-loss netting. Action charges waive or fail rather than debit claims. P and C move together on settleTraderClaim.

title: Frozen-close spread routed to protocol treasury via fee top-up
hypothesis: On an oracle-frozen close, recovered cash is attributed as LP frozen spread, then _settleProtocolFeeTopUp (line 905) pays the same newly arrived pool cash to protocolTreasury, violating LP-owned spread vs protocol-owned fee.
why_not_known_issue: ACCOUNTING_SPEC and EngineExecutionParity require treasury to receive fee not spread. A remaining bug would need recovered spread to be pulled as fee after fee-first allocation.
gate1_reason: _planCloseActionSettlement fee-first caps delta.executionFeeAssets by eligible withheld+collected, then credits protocol fee from that slice only. _recoveredFrozenSpreadAssets subtracts assessed fee + unpaid carry + positive VPI before attributing remainder as spread. Live _settleProtocolFeeTopUp is capped by planned protocolFeeTopUpAssets, which _freePoolCashForProtocolFee computes after collections and, when poolQueuesTradingRevenue, after reserving arrived+retained revenue. Tests in EngineProtocolFees.t.sol assert top-up stops at the protected buffer. No extra spread atoms are credited to treasury.

poc_spec.setup: Oracle-frozen close with large frozenCloseSpreadBps, small executionFeeBps, trader paying from free settlement, pool with LP capital so queuesTradingRevenue is false.
steps: Snapshot treasury CH balance, pool accounted assets, and assessed frozenSpreadAssets.
Execute the frozen close.
Diff treasury credit vs FrozenCloseSpreadSettled recovered vs pool inflow.
poc_spec.assert: Treasury delta equals allocated execution fee (collected + top-up), not recovered spread. Recovered spread remains in pool accounted assets / AlreadyRetained revenue.

title: deposit() credits requested amount without receipt check (FOT / unsolicited USDG)
hypothesis: deposit()/_deposit credits `amount` after safeTransferFrom without measuring received tokens, unlike depositFor which requires received==amount. A fee-on-transfer token would mint extra free settlement. Direct USDG transfers are unrecoverable.
why_not_known_issue: This is the known scan finding (deposit vs depositFor receipt) plus SECURITY.md Settlement-USDG recovery limitation. No new root cause at this pin: settlement is USDG, depositFor already has the exact-receipt check, and unsolicited USDG is documented as unrecoverable.
gate1_reason: Known issue. Live USDG path has no FOT. depositFor (line 371) already enforces received==amount. Unsolicited USDG cannot be withdrawn because withdraw is settlementBalances-based. Owner rescueToken excludes settlement asset.

poc_spec.setup: Not applicable at this pin for USDG; would require a non-USDG FOT settlement asset which is OOS.
steps: Call deposit(amount) with a token that transfers amount-fee.
Compare CH.balanceOf(this) increase vs settlementBalances[account] increase.
poc_spec.assert: Under USDG they match. Under FOT they would diverge — already recorded in audits/.

title: Withdraw of locked buckets / remaining < totalLocked
hypothesis: A trader could withdraw through checkWithdraw and drain PnL pledge, liquidation reserve, committed-order margin, or VPI/bounty action reserve.
gate1_reason: _withdraw provisionally debits settlementBalances then calls engine.checkWithdraw then requires remainingEquity >= totalLockedMargin and settlementBalances >= totalLockedMargin (lines 467-474). Locked buckets are not reduced by withdraw. Sidecar _requireWithdrawPositionHealthy additionally blocks if leftover pledge+claim is liquidatable at the stricter of init vs maint/FAD, if uncovered carry remains, or if VPI floor is underfunded.

poc_spec.setup: Position with pledge, liq reserve, committed order, and VPI rebate reserve.
steps: Attempt withdrawMargin of (free + 1).
Attempt withdraw of an amount that would leave settlementBalances < totalLocked.
poc_spec.assert: Both revert InsufficientFreeEquity / InsufficientAssetsForSettlement / WithdrawBlockedByOpenPosition. Locked buckets unchanged.

title: Opens can leave E < L without degradedMode
hypothesis: processOrder open path does not call _enterDegradedModeIfInsolvent; a crafted open could expand L past E and leave the protocol insolvent with degradedMode still false.
why_not_known_issue: SECURITY.md requires E >= L+B on opens. Remaining bug would need executeOpen to skip that assert or compute a too-small requiredEffectiveAssets.
gate1_reason: planOpen rejects degradedMode and writes requiredEffectiveAssetsAfterAssets = post L + ceil(L * bufferBps / 10000) via SolvencyAccountingLib.hasRequiredSettlementBuffer. executeOpen ends with _assertRequiredEffectiveAssets against live pool.totalAssets() net of claims (line 524). Failure reverts PostOpSolvencyBreach, so the open cannot commit. Close/liq that do leave E < L latch degradedMode in _applyClose/_applyLiquidation (pendingPoolPayout=0 after sidecar payouts already applied). HousePool.payOut skipping L+B on those paths is the documented close-then-latch design.

poc_spec.setup: Pool with E just above L+B. Open that would push L above E.
steps: Submit an increase whose side maxProfit increase makes post L+B > live E.
Observe processOrderTyped result and degradedMode.
poc_spec.assert: Typed SOLVENCY_EXCEEDED or PostOpSolvencyBreach revert. No position write. degradedMode remains false. E and L unchanged.

title: Keeper-injected poolDepth desyncs VPI/solvency from live HousePool cash
hypothesis: Untrusted keepers pass poolDepthAssets into processOrderTyped/liquidatePosition. Sidecar sets snap.poolAssets = poolDepth (line 210) while snap.poolCashAssets = pool.totalAssets() (line 192). Inflated depth would shrink VPI/utilization and could pass E>=L+B against fake assets.
why_not_known_issue: N/A if router is the only caller and always passes totalAssets().
gate1_reason: processOrderTyped/liquidatePosition are onlyRouter. OrderRouter supplies housePool.totalAssets() in the same transaction before planning. Sidecar then re-reads totalAssets() for cash. Keepers cannot call the engine. Trusted-router malice is OOS. Live open assert also re-reads pool.totalAssets(), so a hypothetical fake depth cannot commit an insolvent open.

steps: Call engine.processOrderTyped with poolDepthAssets = type(uint256).max.
Call engine.liquidatePosition with a fake depth.

title: Carry/VPI rounding leaks more than the documented <1 atom
hypothesis: Index floor-div plus position conversion plus VPI WAD math lets a trader extract >1 USDG atom per close via rebate or unpaid carry.
why_not_known_issue: SECURITY.md Rounding limitations already accept <1 atom discarded per carry conversion, no persisted remainder, and VPI lifetime clamp / partial-close linear approximation. Remaining bug needs extractable value above that.
gate1_reason: computeIndexedCarryAssets is floor division and checkpoints even at 0 — documented. CloseAccountingLib lines 112-118 clamp lifetime VPI so proportionalAccrual+vpiDelta cannot go negative, blocking the depth-sandwich rebate. Zero economic depth skips fresh VPI (line 107) but still recovers prior negative VPI. No path found that materializes extra whole atoms beyond those documented floors.

poc_spec.setup: Tiny borrowBase, many user-triggered zero-amount withdraw checkpoints, then a close at manipulated depth.
steps: Open, checkpointCarryIndexes / withdraw(0) many times with sub-atom accrual.
Try open-at-high-depth / reduce-depth / close rebate sandwich.
Sum discarded carry vs closed VPI rebate.
poc_spec.assert: Carry loss per checkpoint < 1e-6 USDG. Sandwich rebate is clamped to lifetime zero. No extra atom paid from pool.

title: recoverExpiredBounty try/catch leaves Active reservation so later take/credit double-pays
hypothesis: Failed expired-bounty recovery keeps the bounty Active; a later takeBountyReservation plus creditBounty pays it, while some other path already unlocked the reserve.
why_not_known_issue: SECURITY.md documents quarantine of inconsistent bounty records. Remaining bug would need Active+already-unlocked reserve that take() still pays.
gate1_reason: recoverExpiredBounty is fail-closed: invariant mismatch quarantines (line 1573) and returns without decreasing the floor. takeBountyReservation only succeeds for Active and then zeros the record before the router transfers. transferReservedSettlement enforces remaining action reserve >= vpi + remaining bounties. creditBounty without a prior take hits that floor and reverts. No double-pay path.

poc_spec.setup: Expired open with Active order bounty; optionally force a ledger mismatch.
steps: Call recoverExpiredBounty on a consistent record vs a quarantined record.
Attempt takeBountyReservation + creditBounty / absorbReservedExecutionBounty twice.
poc_spec.assert: Consistent recover settles once. Quarantined records do not unlock. Second take returns 0 / non-Active. Floor still covers VPI.

title: TerminalNavBookV2 nested-mutation / unauthenticated curve write desync
hypothesis: Inner settlementWritePosition / delete / bounty credit mutates the NAV book without the outer _begin/_endTerminalCurveMutation hash check, desyncing LP NAV from live lots/entry.
why_not_known_issue: SECURITY.md nested-boundary rule: only the outer engine boundary authenticates/syncs.
gate1_reason: _applyOpen/_applyClose/_applyLiquidation all begin the trader (and, for liq bounty, keeper) curve hash before sidecar mutation and end after. settlementWritePosition/Delete are onlySettlementSidecar. TerminalNavBookV2.onlyEngine (book line 124) accepts only the engine. Nested sidecar calls do not re-authenticate; the outer hash still covers the net lots/entry write. Keeper==account skips the second bracket (line 1331).

poc_spec.setup: Open, partial close, liquidation that pays a keeper who also has a live position.
steps: Execute each flow and read TerminalNavBookV2 hash vs engine position lots/entryCost.
Attempt a direct book write from a non-engine account.
poc_spec.assert: Hashes match post-op. Direct book calls revert onlyEngine.

title: Close solvency uses router poolAssets while cash routing uses poolCashAssets, hiding E < L
hypothesis: _computeCloseSolvency builds SolvencyState from snap.poolAssets (execution: caller poolDepth) while payouts/top-up use snap.poolCashAssets (live totalAssets). A mismatch could preview solvency against fake depth while actually draining cash, leaving E < L with no latch if the latch also used the fake number.
why_not_known_issue: Would be new if live latch used the planner's fake E. It does not.
gate1_reason: Live latch (_enterDegradedModeIfInsolvent, CfdEngine.sol:1351) re-reads pool.totalAssets() after sidecar token movements and compares to live _maxLiability(); pendingPoolPayout is 0 because payouts already hit the pool. Router sets poolDepth=totalAssets() in the same tx, so planner and cash fields match on the only live path. Opens additionally assert live E >= L+B.

poc_spec.setup: Close that pays a large immediate profit from a thin pool.
steps: Execute the close through the router.
Compare planner solvency.effectiveAssetsAfterAssets to live P-C and degradedMode.
poc_spec.assert: If live E < L, degradedMode is true. Planner preview on the router path matches live totalAssets observation.
